label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 078 ]

blocks.text: The doctor's receptionist was startled when a nun stormed out of the examining room and left without paying. When the doctor appeared she asked what had happened. "Well." said the doctor, "I examined her and told her she was pregnant." "Doctor!" exclaimed the receptionist. "That can't be!" "Of course not." he replied, "but it sure cured her hiccups."

readingSentences.english: Reading books expands our imagination and broadens our perspective on life.
readingSentences.korean: 책을 읽는 것은 우리의 상상력을 넓혀주고 삶에 대한 시야를 확장시켜 준다.

readingSentences.english: Through literature, we travel to different eras and experience diverse cultures.
readingSentences.korean: 문학을 통해 우리는 서로 다른 시대로 여행하고 다양한 문화를 경험하게 된다.

readingSentences.english: It allows us to understand the feelings and struggles of other human beings.
readingSentences.korean: 그것은 우리가 다른 인간들의 감정과 고뇌를 깊이 이해할 수 있도록 해준다.

readingSentences.english: In this way, reading makes us more tolerant, empathetic, and wise.
readingSentences.korean: 이러한 방식으로 독서는 우리를 더욱 관대하고 공감 능력이 풍부하며 지혜롭게 만들어 준다.
